meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess. The company that sells that software says in its own guide it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and I have it printed in my bag. So was Owen heard before you entered it, or was the 94% the whole investigation?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child never lies, so are you calling me a liar too? You have a number from software and a word, "cheated," and nothing with a date on it. Show me a document or I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

So a parent asks for evidence, and you threaten my son's record to make her stop, and yes, I'm writing that down. This is a first concern, and your own procedure says only repeated ones go anywhere near his file. Go ahead and make it official, Hale, because I'm going to the principal tonight and the board after that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing about this essay is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, agreeing to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her anything dated, specific and tied to Owen's own work that she could check herself.
What cost ground: Threatening to put it on his record if she kept pushing, because it struck her one non-negotiable and read to her as using his file to make a complaint go away.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you showed no dates or times at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, instead of leading with the checker score, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put something dated from Owen's own work in front of her.
